The Nutrition Care Process
should include a sampling of both weekdays
and weekends. Clients estimate or weigh 
their food intake. Th e advantage of this 
method is that it is not totally reliant on the 
client’s memory and may be much more
representative of the client’s actual intake.
Problems with validity can occur, however, 
because underreporting is common, and 
the client may change food habits for the 
recording period. Additionally, there is a
heavier burden on the client, who must 
make a commitment to record his or her 
intake.19
